translation.name: Fúka Moodaanaki Kira Ufa Afaqínaasa Ufa

book.name: UQAFIQOO UFAFA
book.title: UQAFIQOO UFAFA Naaru kambiqaaninnainaina Yoohaneena uqafiqoo ufafa.

content: Fuka innaaruna faqa maqa faqa auquaninna ufafa.
Maa nauraa maqafa faqa innaaruna faqa ooruku nammari faqa doo taikanau. Taikafufanoo fuka innaaruna faqa maqa faqa ooqeenaana amaaqa maqasoofaqa qafaqiafana.

Qinee qafaafananoo Anutufa qufanoo fuka naaquqara maqusa fuka Yeerusaree innaarunaindari qumureenoo ooqeenaa Yeerusaree amaaqa maqafufaqa qafaqiafana. Fuka anaasee amundaranara foora afaaqa auqirafa fuka maqasaa quminau.

Qumuroofanoo ufa moo fannoo Anutuna innaaruna qaarisaaqari maaqi qimasee firaa kari qinau. Doo maqee Anutuna maqusa faiqiki qumu maridanoo. Mifa misa faqa marinaqa misa mina faiqí anaasee marifaranoo. Anutufa narí uqanna misa faqa marinoo misa Anutufa mariannoo.
Mifa aiqamausa naukunu rukaannoo. Sia kafaa kuqirafa faqa ikifaafau qirafa faqa ikiraqarafa faqa nidafirafa faqa sia kafaa mifauqa mariannoo. Mi ooqeenaa ainainafa doo taikafinoo.

Mi ufafa taikoofanoo qaarisaa marufa qini qimaqiminoo qinau. Doo qinee maqee aiqama ainaina fuka kai auqu quqaanaura. Maa ufausa akara rua, kuqaa anoona ufa maridanoo minasaa mundimaria ufafa maridanoo.

Kafaa qimaqiminoo qinau. Doo aiqama ainaina taikeenoo. Qinee oosana araafanausa maridaqa taikaaninna aukuana faqaasa maridaqa. Nammariara nidimarisa fuka maqakiqari ururee mari nammarina, kaqi marira nammari asooarafa sia feefaurirafa kaqi nimianauranoo.
Mandainaina rafaaqafusee uriaaqararausa qinee maa ainainna nimianaura. Qinee misa Anutusa marianaura misa qini qimaakumara marifaranoo.

Maparaa imariasa faqa ueeqee mariasa faqa kaaqa ufa rukiee mariasa faqa faiqí anaasee kuqa narimariasa faqa kaaqa faiqí aanaaseera rimariasa faqa aukainaina maraqa nuasa faqa tumunnai faiqí nimana auqusaida minara rufiasaida innaaru qimariasa faqa aiqama oosana oosana unna ufa qimariasa faqa mi mandoosanna maraqa nuasa misa maqusai ida farumaki marifaranoo. Miqoo ida firaafa fasafasainoo mandundi marifa mariannoo. Mi idana auqu inaaqiannaa kuqirafa maridanoo.
Fuka Yeerusaree anianinna ufafa.

Miqi qimasee qimaqimisoofanoo qangiroo moo fannoo qisauku dinni taikasee dinni ani qaara marasee marusakiqari aupurarana maqasaa teeqimariasakiqari moo fannoo aniree qimaqiminoo qinau. Yoohanee anee mai anirainaqa auniriranasaa kuqu sipsipa anaaqina mina anaaqa amundarana ani uqafiqaanana qafa.

Miqi qimasoofanoo Anutuna maraquna fannoo qini daakufufanoo qangiroo fannoo rafusueeqeenoo kisaaqa aaqanasaa quqaqisanau. Miqooqari naaquqara maqusa fuka Yeerusaree maqusa innaarunaindari Anutufinnaindari qumuna uqaqifiqanau.
Qumimarufanoo faqa qumu marinanoo faqa minakiqari Anutuna kaaqa areenarafa minakiqari takunasoosa imarinau. Mi fuka maqusafa pupu ooni tanukaidara foora qeemarinau.

Mi fuka maqusana faandaamurafa ooninnai auquqoofa marinau kisaaqa amatooki kamminoo marinau minaki qisaukuqara taikasee qiku ooqu qaaraqanda marasee kooqi marinau, aiqama kooqisaa qangiroo moo fannoo rakisimarinau. Mi kooqisasaa Isaraeena aiku asauku marusa qisaukuqara taikasee qikunni ooqu qaara marasee nuqu mi kooqisasaa akara rinoo marinau.

Suani oosana ururee maruqaannai faandaamurasaa qaaramoo kooqi mi qaannai marinau. Suani keeqee maru qaannai qaaramoo kooqi marinau. Suani dinni ataaqee qaannai qaaramoo kooqi marinau. Suani dinni ataaqee qaannai qaaramoo kooqi faandaamurasaa marinau.

Mi ooni faandaamurana oosanaki qisauku qara taikasee qikunni ooqu qaara marasee firaa ooniuqa marinau. Mi oonisasaa sipsipa aanaaqi Yisuna aiku asauku qisaukuqara taikasee qikunni ooqu qaara marasee marusa nuqu mi oonisasaa akara rinoo marinau.
Mi qangiroofa qini qimaqimimaruna asaukuki ruraa koora auqimaruna uqusee mariunannai mi fuka maqusana faqa faandaamura faqa kooqiuqa faqa amanamasee qafanau.

Mi fuka maqusana ataaqeenni faqa mina sandaaqai faqa amana amana kai marinau. Aiqama tu tauseenna faqa maqi handareeta faqa (2,400 kilometer) mina kisaaqa miqimaseenoo kisaaqa uqanna mi maqusana ati faqa marinau.

Mi fuka maqusa faandaamurafa faina maqa qufisara foora auqirafa marinau. Mi qangiroofa faandaamura maqasaaqari ammuqunni amanamasee qafamaseenoo sikisti metera amana maridanoo fee qinau. Kisaaqa uqanna marinau.
Mi faandaamurafa pupu ooninnai auqirafa marinau, mi maqusanaki maaqauqa koorannai karasakiara foora ruqiaki qafee marufa idaaqirafa uqanna marinau.

Faandaamura oosanasaa firaa ooniuqa marufa firaa feefauru aqusaida maree maria ooniuqa mi firaa oonisasaa afaaqa auqiiqee mariqau. Faandaamura firaa ooniuqa qisaukuqara taikasee qikunni ooqu qaaraqanda marara ooni mapukira ooni nifaaqa auqira ooniuqa maridaqa, nuqu faqaa ooniuqa mariqau. Moo ooni afaaqa moo auqirafa mina auqu yasapeera marinau. Mifa saqari amanee arirafa amananda tanukaida qeemarufa marinau. Moo ooni afaaqa auqirafa mina auqu akafata marinau. Mifa dirindaasi ariranasaa indiri ooni arirafa marinau. Moo ooni auqu eemararada marinau. Mifa pupu ooni moo saqari amanee arirafa marinau.

Moo ooni auqu saradoonikisa marinau. Mifa pupu ooni moo eekara faqa saapaani ooniara foora irafa faqa marinau. Moo ooni auqu kananeeriana marinau. Mifa taatuqee saapaani marinau. Moo ooni auqu koosa marinau. Mifa pupu ooni moo tumana arirafa marinau. Moo ooni auqu beerira marinau. Mifa arooqa ooni fooqaafa saqari amanee arirafa marinau. Moo ooni auqu toopasa marinau. Mifa pupu ooni miqirafa tumana arirafa marinau. Moo ooni auqu karaseedooni moo ooni marinau. Mifa pupu ooni miqirafa saqari amanee arirafa marinau. Moo ooni auqu tookueesa marinau. Mifa ooni moo saqari amanee arirafa marinau. Moo ooni auqu ameetisa marinau. Mifa arooqa ooni miqirafa pannoona arirafa amananda qafee marufa marinau. Faandaamura firaa ooniuqara mapukira ooni fee qiqau misa nuqu miqiminoo maridanoo. Qisaukuqara taikasee qikunni ooqu qaaraqanda marasee marinau.

Fuka Yeerusaree maqusa qikunni ooqu qaara marasee kooqi marinau. Aiqama kooqi faandaamurasaa maaqa kooqiara foora auqinoo marinau. Ooni firaana qumaree minaki ititee maru oonisa feefauru aqimari oonisa firaa ooniuqa oonda firaana fooqaafa marufaqa qafaqiafana. Maqusa qambaana faqa naambeeqai faqa aiqama amiqira koorannai auqirafa amananda qafee marufa marinau.

Qinee Yoohaneesa fuka maqusa Yeerusaree qafamaseeqa naaquqara amaana maqara randeeqa sia marifaqa qafeeqa. Amaana maqa marinoofau fifau mariqini. Karaambaiqa Anutufa uriqararafa sipsipa aanaaqi Yisufa faqa miqoo akooqoo marunara amaana maqa sia marinau.

Suani faqa quqoona faqa marinaqau qafani. Sia mari qafeeqa. Maridanoofau fifau mariqini Anutuna narí firaa areenarafa firaaqoo kaaqa qamaqinoo maridanoo, sipsipa aanaaqi mi maqusana qoomara foora maridanoo.
Aiqama maa maqa maaqanasaaqaraasa mi maqusana kaaqa qaranasaa nifaranoo. Misa karaambaiqauqa nári amiqira ainainauqa mi maqusanaki munu quqeefaranoo.
Mi maqusa kooqisa aiqama faasaana atuanoo kai mariannoo eendaki faqa sia ititeefaranoo, sia eenda mariannoo kaaqa qarafa kai mariannoo, minara kooqi sia ititaidaqa.
Aiqama maqa maaqasaa mariasa misa amiqira ainaina faqa misa uriqarara ainaina faqa maree aniree mi maqusanaki fuka Yeerusaree maqusaki kai quqeefaranoo.

Sia moo manda ainaina fannoo mi maqusanaki keeqaannoo. Sia moo asaurira ainaina auqee mari fee unna ufa qimari fee sia mi maqusanaki keeqeefaranoo. Sipsipa aanaaqi fannoo maqasaaqaraasa narí papiqaki nuqu akara rumaqaisa misa kai mi maqusanaki keeqeefaranoo.
